text:
Maya (Product): @here Quick update — GA for the Private/VPC/on-prem telemetry opt-in toggle is available in v2.3.0. TL;DR: customers can now choose to opt in to non-sensitive usage telemetry from the Console, CLI, or Helm during install/upgrade. Docs: https://go.redwood/telemetry-opt-in :tada:

Priya (Security): Important note: existing deployed clusters keep their current setting during upgrade. We will not flip settings to opt-in for already-installed customers.

Sam (Eng): Deploy notes: v2.3.0 adds a new flag and API endpoint. Rolling to staging today, prod next week if no blockers. CLI example: 
```bash
redwood admin telemetry set --enabled=false --scope=cluster
```

Jordan (SRE): Audit & ops: opt-in changes emit audit-log events (redwood.telemetry.change). We'll add a short retention/forwarding note to the runbook. @Alice (Legal) fyi.

Alice (Legal): Quick legal check — opt-in telemetry is limited to anonymized usage metrics by default (no PII). No DPA addendum required for simply enabling metrics; we'll add language to the onboarding materials.

Customer Success: We'll update the kickoff checklist and the shared one-pager we give to new Private customers. Can DevEx provide a short blurb for the one-pager?

Maya (Product): Action items:
- Eng: final migration script to preserve existing settings on upgrade (due Wed)
- DevEx: Console UI toggle + copy (due Fri)
- CS: update onboarding and send the one-pager (due Mon)
- Security: confirm KMS/encryption note for telemetry payloads
Goal: GA rollout to paid Private customers next Tuesday.

deploy-bot: Release v2.3.0-rc1 tagged and pushed to release-candidate branch. CI passing.

Sam (Eng): Helm values sample for installs/upgrades: 
```yaml
redwood:
  telemetry:
    enabled: false        # default for new installs
    send_usage: opt-in    # API/console toggle honored
```

Ravi (Solutions): Quick perf note — expected overhead when telemetry enabled is negligible (<1% CPU, ~50-200KB/min outbound for medium throughput clusters). We'll include these numbers in the FAQ.

Maya (Product): Thanks all. If a compliance-sensitive customer requests zero telemetry, we will provide the air-gapped package and a configuration guide. Please route those requests to @Priya (Security). Full docs & checklist: https://go.redwood/telemetry-opt-in. Any blockers, drop them here or DM me. :thumbsup:
